Sam (CSM): Flagging renewal risk for NorthPoint. Avg daily token usage down ~62% since Monday. New procurement contact (Mark) started last week and wants a vendor bakeoff.
Lina (AE): Oof. Any product errors or billing alerts?
Sam (CSM): No errors; onboarding shows low engagement last two sprint demos. Their workflows for bulk-embed and chat assistant are paused.
signal-bot: [alert] account=NorthPoint severity=high reason=usage_drop pct=62
Mark (Client): Hi team 
We're re-evaluating after a headcount change. Procurement wants a 10-day apples-to-apples comparison against CloudMuse. Key asks: steady-state p95, cost per 100k tokens, and short compliance note.
Diego (Solutions): Recommend Dedicated short trial with warm cache and steady-load run. We'll provide a perf script and cost delta.
Lina (AE): Let's schedule a 30m alignment call this week. Mark, mornings PT or afternoons?
Mark (Client): Afternoons PT please. Also need a one-page checklist so our infra team can run the harness.
Sam (CSM): Playbook: 1) Lina to schedule call (owner: Lina) 2) Diego to craft trial config + perf plan (owner: Diego) 3) Sam to offer an enablement drop-in and compliance blurb (owner: Sam). Deadline: materials by Wed noon.
Lina (AE): Tentative Thu 3pm PT on calendar, will confirm.
Diego (Solutions): I'll upload perf plan and a minimal harness (locust + warmup) by Tue EOD.
Sam (CSM): Marking renewal as "at-risk" until trial completes. Will update renewal board after the call.
Mark (Client): Thank you 
Looking forward to the call.
